title: HSE graduation-guide content schema
description: Content schema for content.kind === "graduation-guide" — a distinct render path from the narrative meta/config/cover/sections model in content.schema.json (v1.2), sharing only the meta/config envelope conventions (project_id, token_set, analytics, pwa) so the existing validate/render/deploy pipeline works unchanged. Promoted from the graduation.guide product repo (graduation-guides/schema/graduation.schema.json) — same content model, now hosted and rendered here per docs/graduation-guide-integration.md. Offline-critical fields must be baked into the artefact at build time; connected-optional fields may be lazy-loaded (future work).

kind.description: Selects this render path in renderer/index.js's render(). Absent/other kind values fall through to the narrative sections renderer.

meta.description: Same envelope shape as content.schema.json's meta — reused so render.js, the Supabase deploy pipeline, and S3/CloudFront paths need zero changes.

project_id.description: Deploy slug, e.g. "imperial-2026". Determines the S3/CloudFront path.

token_set.description: Registry lookup key (tokens/registry.json) — kept for consistency, but this render path sources its actual colors/fonts from institution.* below, not css/tokens-<id>.css, since a guide's sub-brand can diverge from the institution's corporate token set.

group_id.description: Same Tier 2 group mechanism as content.schema.json — links this hub page to its satellite story pages, resolved at render time via renderer/groups.js.

group_label.description: Display label used when this project appears in another group member's nav. Falls back to meta.title if unset.

group_role.description: Free-form tag this kind's own renderer interprets (e.g. 'hub') — not interpreted by the resolver itself.

_groupNavDeployedAs.description: System-managed, not user-editable — see content.schema.json for the full explanation.

plausible_domain.description: Domain registered in Plausible CE, e.g. analytics.har.pn.

pwa.description: Implemented via renderer/pwa.js — a Tier 1 capability (see harpoon-core), not graduation-guide-specific. Set enabled:true to generate manifest.json, sw.js, and app icons at build time. theme_color/background_color are optional overrides; institution.primaryColor/lightBackground are used by default.

theme_color.description: Overrides institution.primaryColor for the manifest/theme-color meta, if set.

background_color.description: Overrides institution.lightBackground for the manifest splash background, if set.

institution.description: Offline-critical. Branding data consumed by the renderer via generated CSS custom properties — never hardcoded in the renderer module itself. Deliberately not sourced from meta.token_set: a guide's real sub-brand (e.g. Imperial's "Graduation Days" dark/teal identity) can diverge from the institution's corporate token set.

shortName.description: Short form for tight UI (e.g. nav wordmark).

logo.description: Path or URL to institution logo. Optional.

fontFiles.description: Font binaries to embed in the build artefact, resolved relative to this renderer's output directory.

file.description: Path relative to the deployed artefact's directory (e.g. fonts/imperial-sans-regular-400.woff2).

footer.description: Not yet rendered by this renderer — reserved for future use.

icons.description: Real institution logo/icon files for the PWA manifest, resolved relative to the deployed artefact's directory. Optional — when omitted, renderer/pwa.js generates a simple placeholder (institution initial on primaryColor) via sharp at build time. Supply this once a real logo is available.

guide.description: Offline-critical. Guide-level copy shared across all ceremonies.

subtitle.description: Not yet rendered by this renderer — reserved for future use.

days.description: Groups ceremonies by calendar day for the chooser section.

active.description: Whether this ceremony is selected by default on load.

prizesIntro.description: Ceremony-specific — must not be hardcoded in the shared renderer.

subGroups.description: Optional finer-grained split within a course group (e.g. a suite of MBA programmes). Omit 'students' on the parent group when subGroups is present.

searchIndex.description: Flat cross-ceremony search index, derived from ceremonies/courseGroups at build time. Never de-duplicate — duplicate names across ceremonies are different people.
